item.title: Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams
item.description: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it.
